spec_case: issue #403: an over-limit index chain is rejected at compile time, not evaluation
description: A 39-level index chain (state.input.a[0][0]...) is well past the explicit nesting limit (32) both engines now enforce. It is rejected when the document is compiled -- before any effect runs, and before the unset-path/real-data distinction that used to decide whether this shape failed at evaluation or not even mattered. No real data (`-e a=...`) is needed any more: the document never reaches a point where it would be read.
